institutionName: Università degli Studi di Napoli Federico II

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The possibility of learning from professors from all of Europe and hear about the different master degrees within my interrests outside of Denmark. It was also to learn from and meet other professors in a specific field.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was such an incredible experience and I hope other people get the chance to do something similar.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I had to send an application to the professor who invited me, with my grades and a motivational letter. Then I was lucky to be chosen for the experience. Then we got some Emails from the host institution and I just had a small problem with a administrative worker at the host institution, who didn't want to sign my learning agreement. Everthing else worked smoothly.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I could write my own professor.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was very different, since we had lectures in very specific topics and not so overall. But this was what made it so interesting. Also we were lucky to see different locations and to go on excursions in Italy. It was an very "all-around" experience of Napoli.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Stay hydrated! It's very very hot, but I loved it.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be patient. The italian culture is a bit more laid-back which means we are not always exactly on schedule - so go with the flow and don't be stressed.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The culture meeting with other exchange students, local students and all the different professors. And also finding SO much inspiration for my future - such as Master programs and other exchange opportunities.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The days were quite long - from 9-18 but they made sure to have breaks and snacks which was nice. So i do understand we had to have a tight schedule but I was a bit tired at some of the lectures.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Meeting the professors was such amazing it was a shame some of the lectures ended up being online.
